pass_criterion: Fresh install blocks product entry until age affirmation and current legal versions are accepted.
With internet disabled, create a local identity and profile without phone/email/social login.
Capture BLE advertisements for 15 minutes; rotating IDs change and no PII appears.
Process 100 synthetic peers and at least 20 real/simulated active peers with no duplicate cards or UI stall.
Full profile, text chat and media actions remain blocked until both users accept.
Android and iOS users on different networks exchange E2E text after leaving local range.
Locked-screen push contains no message or sensitive profile text by default.
Transfer a photo, interrupt local path, resume missing chunks and publish exactly one verified object.
Record, cancel, send, pause and resume Bluetooth-only voice note; verify no remote upload.
A sends eligible opaque packet to C through B; B cannot decrypt and TTL/dedup rules hold.
Begin on BLE, enable/disable fast local path and confirm session/message identity persists with no duplicate.
Run on devices without Wi-Fi Aware/peer-to-peer acceleration; baseline experience remains available.
Activate signed venue package without binary update; invalid/expired package is rejected.
Redeem a valid voucher once; second redemption, expired and revoked cases fail gracefully.
Sponsored card appears only in Discover/approved venue surface and never overlays Nearby, Match or Chat.
Complete subscription and consumable tests in both store sandboxes, then restore durable entitlement after reinstall.
Publish valid config, tamper next version, verify rejection and last- known-good rollback.
Block peer and verify disappearance from discovery, mesh, relay notifications and venue rooms.
Trigger deliberate wipe and verify local profile, messages, cache, queue, venue tokens and keys are removed to specification.
Run golden vectors and live Android- Android, iOS-iOS and Android-iOS sessions for all message classes.
Continuous discovery, remote text and periodic media completes without crash, ANR or unbounded memory growth.
Report, mute, block, moderation and room closure flows satisfy policy checklist.
Pass TalkBack/VoiceOver, large text, reduced motion, compact/expanded, tablet and foldable checks.
Inspect logs, analytics, crash reports and support bundle; no prohibited plaintext or sensitive dimensions are present.
With no local path and no internet, eligible text/media enters correct queue state; app does not claim delivery.
Disable nearby, mesh, media, venue room and ads independently using signed config without reinstall.
Flood requests, room posts, mesh packets and malformed media; limits activate without crash.
API/SDK targets, privacy declarations, age rating, billing and UGC materials pass internal store checklist.
All golden-vector suites (framing, crypto, media, adv, config, voucher, errors) pass identically in Java, Swift and Go in the release pipeline; negative vectors fail with exact stable error codes.
Spoofed, replayed and truncated advertisements never produce a nearby card; cards appear only after authenticated HELLO and age out on schedule.
Under simulated congestion, thermal pressure and battery saver, duty cycles reduce in stages, honest states show, and no crash, storm or false success occurs.
Header/documentation/architecture lints pass with zero warnings; trace matrix is complete and fresh; every P0 is tested or owner-signed UNPROVEN.
DPIA, RoPA, market matrix sign-offs, export declarations and store privacy declarations are present and mutually consistent with shipped behavior.
